pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark brown patches with moderately rounded vertices and relatively smooth edge gradients. Patch area is significantly larger on the upper flank and lower neck, decreasing in size and increasing in fragmentation towards the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. The topology features clearly defined junction nodes, primarily tri-radial in structure. Pathway thickness remains relatively uniform across the central flank, ensuring distinct separation of dark regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette along the dorsal ridge of the neck and shoulder. The mane presents a continuous jagged 1D contour against the out-of-focus background.
